description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontHot TubGULF FRONT/CORNER/PRIVATE BEACH, Walk to Gulf Place, 1 Set Beach Chairs*, 4 Bikes, ‘San Remo’The SpaceThe pictures tell it all! San Remo 301, located in Blue Mountain, on the Gulf side of 30A, has been architecturally detailed in a unique manner that provides stunning water views from the living room, dining room, kitchen, master bedroom and queen guest room. At 2100 sq. ft., this is one of only 4 oversized END units in this complex, providing ample living area, a large wrap-around balcony with multiple seating areas and a large dining table. This unit overlooks the beach, the fountain pond inhabited with turtles and the Olympic size pool & hot tub.Guests will truly feel relaxed in the king master bedroom with morning views of the Gulf. Unwind in the serenity of the oversized master bathroom with your own private Jacuzzi bathtub and oversized shower. The second guest room is outfitted with TWO queen beds, private bathroom and flat-screen TV. Nestled in the adjacent corner is a cozy twin over twin bunk room (third bedroom) with their own flat-screen TV, perfect for the kids! The fourth guest room with a Queen bed boasts gorgeous views! The living/dining area is wide open and includes a 52” widescreen TV. Guests will never want to leave!San Remo is one of the finest beachfront complexes on 30A. As a private, gated community that is only 4 stories, there is never an overcrowded feeling. The San Remo beach area is beautiful, spacious, and uncrowded. The combination of convenient beach access and the fountain pond provide a truly unique atmosphere. Remember, all beaches are not created equal!Just out the front door and about a five-minute walk to the west, you’ll find yourself at Gulf Place.Restaurants, Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy Shop, Shunk Gulley (Live music, sports screens and great oysters); Growler’s Garage, (upscale custom brewed beers), coffee & cupcake shop and a general store are among the local offerings to top off your beach vacation at San Remo. Located on the 18+ mile asphalt bike/walking trail, it provides unlimited entertainment opportunities for all ages, including summer concerts on the Gulf Place Green.When your beach day concludes, you can hop in the car & head 5 miles east on 30A to Watercolor and Seaside for shopping & dining or take a 20-minute drive west and explore fine shopping at Silver Sands Outlet Mall and Grand Boulevard shopping center, offering a wonderful array of dining choices-Cantina Loredo, Mitchell's Fish Market and Restaurant, Tommy Bahamas Tropical Cafe, and Flemings Steak House. You can also enjoy in theater dining at the movie theatre in Miramar Beach. Baytowne Wharf in Sandestin is also a quick drive which offers quaint shops, numerous restaurants, nightclubs, live open-air concerts, and great people watching, or continue on to Destin for fishing, dining and shopping galore!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival***1 set beach chairs and umbrella included - March 1 through October 31st.*Heated Community Pool for Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years, and Spring BreakSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom - King sized bed, private en suite bath with jacuzzi tub and walk-in shower.Guest Bedroom # 1- Two queen beds, private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Guest Bedroom # 2 - One queen bed, private bathroom with tub/shower combo, walk in closet.Bunk Room - Twin over twin bunks, shared bathroom. Please note this bedroom has a door but no closet.HOME HIGHLIGHTS:* Two Elevators in Complex* Pack and play provided* Complimentary WIFI* Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service* Pool Heated Thanksgiving and Christmas Weeks* Olympic sized pool and hot tub* 4 Adult Bikes* End Unit* 1 Set Beach Chairs Included-SeasonallyAREA ATTRACTIONS:Blue Mountain Beach offers a variety of activities for those seeking a relaxing yet fulfilling getaway. The stunning beaches are the main attraction, with soft, sugar-white sand and clear, calm waters perfect for swimming, paddleboarding, or simply unwinding under the sun. The nearby Coastal Dune Lakes—rare freshwater lakes that meet the Gulf of Mexico—offer opportunities for kayaking, fishing, and birdwatching. For dining, visitors can explore a selection of local restaurants that emphasize fresh seafood and coastal cuisine. Local favorites include Shunk Gulley, known for its lively atmosphere and delicious seafood dishes, and Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, where you can enjoy homemade ice cream while taking in the picturesque views. For those who enjoy exploring, the surrounding area offers biking trails, boutique shopping, and the scenic charm of nearby nature preserves, making it easy to immerse yourself in the beauty of the Gulf Coast while indulging in outdoor adventures and local flavors.Show less
